title: Demonic Path Summons
next_chapter_hook: When the Demonic Path Commander spoke the words 'The Convergence of Three Realms,' the Heavenly Fate Mark on Chen Ji's palm suddenly burned scorching hot—it was the signal that the Eye of Heaven was gazing upon this place.

text.content: That sigh pierced through the void, transforming into a scorching rune in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. The rune writhed like a living creature, and in the blink of an eye, it seared itself onto his palm—it was the Summoning Order of the Demonic Path Commander. The Imperial Capital's barrier was laughably fragile before this force, like morning mist meeting the scorching sun.

Chen Ji lowered his head to look at his palm, where the dark red rune pulsed with his heartbeat, each beat draining a thread of Heavenly Fate Value. He narrowed his eyes, but the corner of his mouth curled into a cold smirk instead. Was the Demonic Path Commander so eager to meet because he was afraid Chen Ji would run?

dialogue.content: 「Here they come.」 The voice of the remnant soul guardian rang out in his Mental Sea, carrying a trace of solemnity, 「The Demonic Path Commander has already sensed the aura of the Tianji Record. He's not waiting for you, this useless disciple, but rather... that page of the fragment.」

text.content: Chen Ji did not immediately respond to Mo Xiansheng's words. Instead, he flipped open the first page of the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickered slightly, as if waiting for his decision. Chen Ji suddenly laughed lightly: 「The Demonic Path Commander wants to see me? Then let me meet this old friend.」

dialogue.content: Just then, a black shadow landed silently on the windowsill. Ye Qing wore a black cloak, her hair disheveled by the night wind, her eyes filled with panic: 「Chen Ji, have you gone mad? Once you accept the Demonic Path Commander's Summoning Order, your life and death are in his hands!」

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze passing over Ye Qing to look at the night sky in the distance. There, black clouds churned, with faint blood-colored light flickering—it was the omen of the demonic army pressing in. He slowly rose, showing the summoning rune on his palm to Ye Qing: 「Tell me, if I don't go, will he just attack directly?」

dialogue.content: Ye Qing bit her lip, her hands hidden beneath the cloak clenching into fists. She drew out a token from her embrace, black as ink: 「I have a concealment talisman from the Holy Sect. The barrier of the Myriad Demon Abyss is useless to you, but I can...」 Her voice dropped, 「I can follow you secretly.」

text.content: Chen Ji glanced at her, neither refusing nor thanking. He merely pressed the summoning rune deeper into his palm. The moment his blood fused with the rune, a majestic demonic energy engulfed him entirely. The Imperial Capital rapidly receded from his vision, replaced by an endless abyss of darkness—the Myriad Demon Abyss.

Falling. He knew not how long had passed before Chen Ji's feet touched solid ground. He looked around, everywhere was jagged black rock, with dark red demonic blood flowing on the cavern walls, the air filled with the stench of sulfur and decay. In the distance came the shrieks of countless demonic creatures, yet none dared approach him by a hair's breadth—because beneath his feet lay the only path leading to where the Demonic Path Commander resided.

A figure emerged slowly from the black mist. He appeared to be an ordinary middle-aged man, dressed in plain blue robes, his face so kind and friendly he looked like someone's neighbor. But Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—this was the Demonic Path Commander, that supreme villain who had single-handedly stirred up the winds and clouds across the Three Realms.

dialogue.content: 「You've come.」 The Demonic Path Commander's voice was impossibly gentle, 「I've been waiting for you for a long time, Chen Ji—or should I say, the current inheritor of the Tianji Record.」 He raised his hand, pointing to the position of Chen Ji's chest, 「Hand it over. It never belonged to you in the first place.」

text.content: Chen Ji did not move. He merely tilted his head slightly, gazing at the other party with an expression like someone watching a show: 「Hand it over to you? Are you certain you want the Tianji Record, and not... another yourself?」

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander's gaze finally changed. He fell silent for a moment, then burst into laughter: 「Good! Excellent! What a master of meticulous planning, Chen Ji! Truly deserving of his reputation.」 His smile gradually faded, 「Since you've already guessed, I'll speak directly—we are both pieces on the board, playthings of that ultimate Chess Player.」

choice.prompt: Facing the Demonic Path Commander's proposal for cooperation, Chen Ji chose...

choices.description: Agree to cooperate with the Demonic Path Commander while secretly observing his true intentions, using the Tianji Record to predict his next move.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Path Commander's trust, unlock the Myriad Demon Abyss intelligence network
choices.risk_hint: May be reverse-exploited by the other party

text.content: Chen Ji nodded slightly, putting on an expression of careful deliberation: 「Since we are both pieces on the board, let us join hands and overturn this chessboard.」 The moment his words fell, a flash of imperceptible keen light flickered through the Demonic Path Commander's eyes.

choices.description: Refuse the Demonic Path Commander's proposal on the spot, use words to provoke the other party, probe his bottom line and true strength.
choices.visible_cost: Relationship with the Demonic Path Commander shattered
choices.visible_reward: See through the other party's true strength, inspire potential and break through

text.content: Chen Ji let out a cold laugh: 「Overturn the board? You're merely another larger piece on the board, yet you actually think highly of yourself.」 The air suddenly solidified, the kind expression on the Demonic Path Commander's face vanished entirely, replaced by a suffocating oppressive aura.

choices.text: Probe the other party's bottom line
choices.description: Make no statement but instead ask for details, understand the true meaning of Destiny's Twin Children and the identity of the ultimate Chess Player.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence: partial truth about the ultimate Chess Player
choices.risk_hint: May have information extracted by the other party

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. Instead, he slowly walked toward the black rock carved with countless runes. He reached out to touch those runes, sensing the power flowing within: 「Destiny's Twin Children... Your destiny and my destiny are bound by the same law. What exactly is this law?」

dialogue.content: 「You're very clever.」 The Demonic Path Commander waved his hand, and a blurry star map appeared in the void, 「The Eye of Heaven—that is the ultimate Chess Player. It treats every generation of prophets as pieces on the board, and the Tianji Record is merely one of its pieces spread throughout the world. As for you and me, for reasons that cannot be spoken of, we are bound to the same law—Destiny's Twin Children, if one prospers, both prosper; if one perishes, both perish.」

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the star map, his pupils reflecting the trajectories of countless stars. He suddenly remembered what Mo Xiansheng had once said—the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the inevitable counterattack of destiny. Now it seemed this counterattack was probably not directed at him alone.

Just then, a commotion echoed from the depths of the Myriad Demon Abyss. The Demonic Path Commander's brow furrowed slightly as he looked into the darkness: 「Someone has breached the barrier.」 His tone carried a playful interest, 「Is it your friend? That demonic saint maiden... she is quite loyal.」

dialogue.content: From the distance came Ye Qing's cold, clear voice: 「Chen Ji! I've come to rescue you!」 This was followed by the shrieks of demonic creatures and the clashing of swords against metal. The Demonic Path Commander looked at Chen Ji with great interest: 「Your person here—shall I take care of it for you?」

choice.prompt: Ye Qing is in crisis. What is Chen Ji's choice?

choices.description: Regardless of the Demonic Path Commander's attitude, rush directly toward where Ye Qing is. Prove with action: whoever touches my people is my enemy.
choices.visible_cost: May tear apart with the Demonic Path Commander
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing's affection increases significantly, unlock prerequisite for 「Shared Destiny」
choices.risk_hint: Provoke the Demonic Path Commander, consequences unpredictable

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's gaze turned ice-cold in an instant. His figure flashed as he darted toward the source of the commotion: 「Whoever dares to touch her, I will overturn this Myriad Demon Abyss!」 His voice echoed through the abyss, carrying indomitable killing intent.

choices.description: Do not act immediately, but use the Tianji Record to foresee the next three hours of developments, judging whether Ye Qing's situation is truly dangerous.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete foresight, discover that the Demonic Path Commander was testing your reaction

text.content: Chen Ji did not move, but golden light had already silently泛起 in his palm. The Tianji Record's ability unfolded within his Mental Sea—he wanted to see through the truth behind this commotion—Was this the Demonic Path Commander's test, or a genuine crisis?

However, contrary to everyone's expectations, the Demonic Path Commander suddenly laughed: 「Very well, let her in.」 With a wave of his hand, the demonic mist surrounding Ye Qing immediately dispersed, revealing the young woman's slightly disheveled figure. Her cloak was torn, her arms marked with several bloody gashes, but her eyes remained defiant.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stumbled forward, placing herself protectively in front of Chen Ji: 「What do you want to do to him?」 Her voice trembled, but her posture was like a small beast with its fur bristling. The Demonic Path Commander watched her, his playful interest deepening: 「Interesting... the inheritor of the Tianji Record actually has someone willing to protect him with her life.」

text.content: Chen Ji reached out to pull Ye Qing to his side, whispering: 「Don't act rashly.」 Then he raised his head, directly facing the Demonic Path Commander: 「Now, can we continue discussing business? You said the Eye of Heaven is gathering strength, and the final chess game will begin at the Convergence of Three Realms—what does this mean?」

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander stood with hands clasped behind his back, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes: 「The Convergence of Three Realms is where the barriers between the Human, Ghost, and Immortal Realms are at their thinnest. There, a power from ancient times is sealed... The Eye of Heaven wishes to use that power to completely erase all uncontrollable variables.」 He paused, 「Including you, including me.」

text.content: Ye Qing drew a sharp breath, unconsciously gripping Chen Ji's hand tighter. Chen Ji, however, did not respond to her gesture. He quietly stared at the Demonic Path Commander. The blood-colored light of the Myriad Demon Abyss cast upon his face, making his expression dark and uncertain. At this moment, he had already made his calculations—but he would not speak them out now.

The Demonic Path Commander seemed to see through his thoughts, smiling faintly: 「Under the binding of the Law of Destiny, neither you nor I can escape the gaze of the Eye of Heaven acting alone. But if we join forces... perhaps there is still a sliver of hope.」 He extended his hand, and a token as black as ink appeared in his palm, 「This is the treasure of the Demonic Holy Sect. Whoever holds it can command one hundred thousand demonic soldiers. Take it, and meet me at the Convergence of Three Realms.」

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander extends the demonic army token. Chen Ji's final decision is...

choices.description: Take the token, indicating willingness to cooperate with the Demonic Path Commander. This token will be a crucial bargaining chip at the Convergence of Three Realms.
choices.visible_cost: Owe a favor to the Demonic Path Commander
choices.visible_reward: Gain command of one hundred thousand demonic soldiers, unlock demonic faction support
choices.risk_hint: May be viewed as a demonic accomplice

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then finally reached out to take the token. The moment the token entered his hand, a cold force surged into his meridians, creating a strange resonance with the aura of the Tianji Record. He tucked the token into his chest, 「I'll be there at the Convergence of Three Realms.」

choices.description: Do not accept the Demonic Path Commander's enticement, insist on independent action. The token may be good, but the price is unpredictable.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent status, owe no one favors
choices.risk_hint: Will fight alone at the Convergence of Three Realms

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not reach out his hand. He merely folded his hands within his sleeves, gazing at the Demonic Path Commander with a half-smile: 「I appreciate the kind gesture, but I don't need this token. I'll get to the Convergence of Three Realms on my own.」 The Demonic Path Commander's eyes flickered slightly, then broke into a smile: 「Interesting... you're more intriguing than I imagined.」

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander showed no anger; instead, he smiled even deeper. He put away the token and turned to walk into the depths of darkness: 「In that case, I'll see you at the Convergence of Three Realms. By then, you can witness the true face of that ultimate Chess Player with your own eyes.」 His voice gradually faded, 「By the way—the Eye of Heaven has already begun gazing upon you, Chen Ji. Cherish the time you have left.」

As the Demonic Path Commander's figure vanished, the demonic energy of the Myriad Demon Abyss gradually calmed. Ye Qing supported Chen Ji's arm, her voice still somewhat trembling: 「He... he was really the Demonic Path Commander? I thought it would be a fierce battle.」 Chen Ji lowered his head to look at his palm; the summoning rune had already vanished, replaced by a faint blood-colored scar—a mark left by the Law of Destiny's Twin Children.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gently pushed away Ye Qing's hand, raising his head to gaze at the blood-red night sky above the Myriad Demon Abyss. He suddenly laughed softly, the laughter echoing through the empty abyss, carrying an inexplicable nuance: 「A fierce battle? Miss, do you think I've won many head-on battles in this lifetime?」

text.content: Ye Qing was stunned for a moment, then immediately understood his meaning—this seemingly useless man never relied on brute strength to win. She watched Chen Ji's slender yet upright back, and suddenly felt much more at ease. No matter what lay ahead, at least the person she had chosen to follow had never disappointed her.

Chen Ji turned around, leading Ye Qing toward the exit of the Myriad Demon Abyss. His pace was neither fast nor slow, as if he were merely on an ordinary night stroll. But within his mind, the pages of the Tianji Record were quietly turning—Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded: 「Master, do you trust him?」 Chen Ji did not answer; he merely curled his lips into a meaningful arc.
